## Birthweight Z-Score Differential Expression Analysis - PCA Cell Proportions Adjustment
This code will be used to evaluate the association between birthweight z-score and the placental transcriptome. We will adjust for cell types via PCA in this analysis.This analysis is completed in CANDLE and PATHWAYS GAPPS (N=1009) 

### Load Packages
```{r load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(edgeR)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(biomaRt)
```

### Load Data
```{r load data}
#Load Filtered Normalized RNAseq Data
load(file="/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/FilteredNormalized_RNAseq_CANDLEGAPPS_N1009_112125.RData")

#Loading the covariates for the N=1009 CANDLE/GAPPS Datasets
#This is the updated version with the BW_ZScores
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/FilteredCovariates_CANDLEGAPPS_111825.RData")


#Loading Cell Proportions Data
load(file="/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/DeconvolutionData/ImputedCellProportions_withcollapse_CANDLEGAPPS_N1009_111825.RData")
```

### Fix Data Class
```{r Covar Data Class Fix}
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars)
#Fix covariates with empty factor levels
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Parity <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Parity, levels=c("0", "1"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$FetalSex <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$FetalSex, levels=c("F", "M"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$RaceCollapsed <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$RaceCollapsed, levels=c("1", "2", "3", "6", "7"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Ethnicity <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Ethnicity, levels=c("0", "1"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Batch <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Batch, levels=c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7"))

#Get rid of empty factor levels
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars <- droplevels(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars)

```

### Check Data Order
```{r}
identical(colnames(Y_norm$counts), CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$pathways_id)
identical(colnames(Y_norm$counts), ciber_cells_impute_res$pathways_id)
ciber_cells_impute_res <- ciber_cells_impute_res[
  match(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$pathways_id, ciber_cells_impute_res$pathways_id),
]
identical(colnames(Y_norm$counts), ciber_cells_impute_res$pathways_id)

```

### Cell Type PCA
```{r cell type PCA}
CellProp <- ciber_cells_impute_res
rownames(CellProp) <- CellProp$pathways_id
CellProp <- CellProp %>%
  dplyr::select(-pathways_id)

PCobj =prcomp(CellProp, scale=TRUE)
PCs = PCobj$x
PCs =as.data.frame(PCs[,1:10])

summary(PCobj)$importance["Proportion of Variance", 1:10]


#Will adjust for PCs that account for at least 5% of the variance: PCs 1-7
#They account for ~70% of the variance.

#Let's save the PCs in case we need them later
#write.csv(PCs, "/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/BirthweightTranscriptome/CellType_PCs_112125.csv")

```

### Finalize Covars
For this analysis we will adjust for: Parity, Fetal Sex, Maternal Age, Maternal BMI, Maternal Race, Maternal Ethnicity, Maternal Education, Prenatal Smoking, Gestational Age, Prenatal Alcohol Use, Labor Type, Delivery Method, RNAseq batch and PCs of cell type proportions that account for at least 5% of the variance.
```{r}
SelectedCovars <- CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, bw_z, Parity, FetalSex, Age, BMI, RaceCollapsed, Ethnicity, EducationCollapsed, SmokingComposite, Alcohol, LaborType, DeliveryMethod, Batch)
rownames(SelectedCovars) <- SelectedCovars$pathways_id

PCs_5Percent <- PCs[,1:7]

identical(rownames(PCs_5Percent), rownames(SelectedCovars))
SelectedCovars <- SelectedCovars %>%
  dplyr::select(-pathways_id)

SelectedCovars <- cbind(SelectedCovars, PCs_5Percent)

identical(colnames(Y_norm$counts), rownames(SelectedCovars))
```


### Run Differential Expression Analysis
For this analysis we will adjust for: Parity, Fetal Sex, Maternal Age, Maternal BMI, Maternal Race, Maternal Ethnicity, Maternal Education, Prenatal Smoking,Prenatal Alcohol Use, Labor Type, and Delivery Method, RNAseq Batch, AND cell type PCs that account for at least 5% of variance.
```{r DEG Analysis}
Covars <- colnames(SelectedCovars)
formula_str <- paste("~", paste(Covars, collapse = " + "))
mod <- model.matrix(as.formula(formula_str), data = SelectedCovars)
  dim(mod)

  v<-voom(Y_norm, mod, plot=TRUE) 
  designMatrix<-v$design
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(v, designMatrix))
Results<-topTable(fit, coef=2,number=dim(fit)[1],adjust.method="BH") #Coefficent 2 is BW
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(Results$P.Value,breaks=20)
plot(Results$logFC,-log(Results$P.Value, base=10),ylim=c(0,15),pch=16,cex=0.5,,ylab="Log P Value",xlab="logFC")
  Cutoff<-0.05/dim(Results)[1]
  abline(h=-log(Cutoff, base=10),lwd=2,lty=2,col="blue")
  abline(h=-log(0.05, base=10),lwd=1.5,lty=2,col="azure4")


#save(Results, file="/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_FullResults_CellPropPCA_112125.Rdata")

#write.csv(Results, "/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_FullResults_CellPropPCA_112125.csv")

```

### Volcano Plot
```{r vplot}
MakeVPlot <- function(Results, Title){
  # Filter for significant genes (FDR < 0.05)
  sig <- Results[Results$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
  sig <- sig[order(sig$adj.P.Val), ]
  
  # Separate up and down regulated genes
  sig_up <- sig[sig$logFC > 0, ]
  sig_down <- sig[sig$logFC < 0, ]
  
  # Colors from RdBu palette
  ColorPalette <- brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(2:4, 8:10)]
  color_up <- ColorPalette[3]
  color_down <- ColorPalette[4]
  
  # Top 5 significant genes
  top5 <- head(sig, 10)
  
  # Create the plot
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  
  p <- ggplot(Results, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    geom_point(color = "grey60", size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = sig_up, color = color_up, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = sig_down, color = color_down, size = 1.2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top5, aes(label = genes),
                    size = 3,
                    max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.4,
                    point.padding = 0.2,
                    segment.size = 0.3,
                    segment.color = "black") +
    labs(title = Title,
         x = "Effect Estimate",
         y = "Negative Log(p-value)") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 0.5), ylim = c(0, 10.5)) +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face="bold"))
  
  return(p)
}
MakeVPlot(Results, "Birthweight Z-Scores w/Cell Proportion PCs")
```
